formula_or_test: SPFM = 1 - (lambda_SPF + lambda_RF) / lambda_SR_HW where lambda_SR_HW = lambda_SPF + lambda_RF + lambda_MPF + lambda_S; expressed as percentage: SPFM% = SPFM × 100
inputs: lambda_SPF: failure rate of single-point faults
lambda_RF: failure rate of residual faults
lambda_MPF: failure rate of multi-point faults
lambda_S: failure rate of safe faults
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
clause_locator: Clause 8.4.5, Table 4; Annex C Equation C.7
publicly_retrievable: Purchase required (ISO); partial PDF mirrors may exist
volatility: Low — ISO 26262 amendments are multi-year cycles

formula_or_test: LFM = 1 - (lambda_MPF_L) / (lambda_SR_HW - lambda_SPF - lambda_RF); expressed as percentage: LFM% = LFM × 100 where lambda_MPF_L is the failure rate of latent multi-point faults
inputs: lambda_MPF_L: failure rate of latent multi-point faults
lambda_SR_HW: total safety-related hardware failure rate
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
publicly_retrievable: Purchase required (ISO); partial PDF mirrors may exist

calculation: Probabilistic Metric for random Hardware Failures (PMHF)
formula_or_test: PMHF = lambda_SPF + lambda_RF + lambda_DPF_det × lambda_DPF_latent × T_lifetime; simplified approximation: PMHF ≈ EEC_sum / (2 × T_lifetime) + sum of all single-point contributions
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
clause_locator: Clause 9.4.2; Annex F; ISO 26262-10 for detailed calculation guidance
publicly_retrievable: Purchase required (ISO); partial PDF mirrors may exist

calculation: US EAR Total Processing Performance (TPP) for ECCN 3A090/4A090 classification
formula_or_test: TPP = 2 × MacTOPS × bit_length_of_operation, aggregated over all processing units on the IC; Performance_density = TPP / applicable_die_area_mm2
inputs: MacTOPS: MAC operations per second per processing unit
applicable_die_area_mm2: die area in mm2 using non-planar transistor architecture dies
authority: Export Administration Regulations (EAR), 15 CFR Parts 730-774; Advanced Computing and Supercomputing Rule (AC/S IFR, October 2023)
clause_locator: ECCN 3A090 Technical Notes; 15 CFR Part 774 Supplement 1
publicly_retrievable: Freely available — published in Federal Register and BIS website
volatility: High — thresholds updated October 2022, October 2023; subject to further rulemaking

calculation: US EAR ECCN 3A090 control parameter thresholds (post-AC/S October 2023)
formula_or_test: 3A090.a: TPP >= 4800, OR (TPP >= 1600 AND performance_density >= 5.92); 3A090.b: (TPP >= 2400 AND <4800 AND performance_density >= 1.6 AND <5.92) OR (TPP >= 1600 AND performance_density >= 3.2 AND <5.92); Note 2 carve-out: IC not designed/marketed for datacenters AND TPP < 4800 => not 3A090
inputs: performance_density: TPP divided by applicable die area
authority: Export Administration Regulations (EAR), 15 CFR Parts 730-774; Advanced Computing and Supercomputing IFR (October 2023)
volatility: High — threshold values changed between October 2022 and October 2023 rules

calculation: JEDEC FIT rate calculation from HTOL test data
formula_or_test: lambda = chi2(CL, 2f+2) / (2 × SS × t_stress × AF); FIT = lambda × 10^9; where chi2 is chi-squared distribution, f = number of failures, SS = sample size, t_stress = stress hours, AF = acceleration factor; typical parameters: CL = 60%, f = 0
inputs: chi2: chi-squared quantile at confidence level CL
t_stress: stress test duration in hours
AF: acceleration factor from use to stress condition
authority: JEDEC JESD85 Methods for Calculating Failure Rates in Units of FITs
clause_locator: JESD85 Annex; Equation 1 / method varies by data completeness level
publicly_retrievable: Purchase required (JEDEC); some manufacturer summaries freely available
volatility: Low — JESD85 stable; JESD85A is current version

calculation: Arrhenius temperature acceleration factor for semiconductor reliability
formula_or_test: AF = exp[(Ea/k) × (1/T_use - 1/T_stress)]; where Ea = activation energy (typically 0.7 eV for semiconductor failures, 0.5-0.8 eV used depending on mechanism), k = Boltzmann constant (8.617×10^-5 eV/K), T in Kelvin
inputs: T_stress: stress test temperature in Kelvin
authority: JEDEC JESD85 Methods for Calculating Failure Rates in Units of FITs; also referenced in JEDEC JESD22-A108
clause_locator: JESD85 Equation 1; also JESD22-A108 Temperature Acceleration section
publicly_retrievable: Purchase required (JEDEC); widely summarized in manufacturer reliability documents

calculation: CHIPS Act advanced manufacturing investment credit (AMIC)
formula_or_test: AMIC = 25% × qualified_investment; qualified_investment = value of buildings and depreciable tangible property for advanced semiconductor manufacturing facilities; construction must begin 2023-01-01 through 2026-12-31
inputs: qualified_investment: eligible capital expenditures for semiconductor manufacturing facilities
authority: CHIPS Act of 2022 (Public Law 117-167), Section 107; Internal Revenue Code Section 48D
publicly_retrievable: Freely available — public law, Federal Register, IRS guidance
volatility: Low — statutory credit rate and window are fixed; IRS rulemaking may refine definition
